seoTitle: Fullmetal Alchemist Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Fullmetal Alchemist test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Edward, Alphonse, Roy Mustang, Riza Hawkeye, Winry, Hughes, Armstrong, Izumi or Ling — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the prodigy, the gentle soul or the big softie? Answer 12 everyday questions about family, work and friendship, and find out which Fullmetal Alchemist character you are.

characters.name: Edward
characters.title: The Prodigy
characters.summary: Brilliant, bold and stubborn as anything. You'll take on the world, just don't comment on your height.
description: Like Edward, you're seriously gifted. He became the youngest State Alchemist in history, at just 12.
You've got a temper. Ed is famously sensitive about his height, and overreacts every time someone calls him short.
You don't let setbacks stop you. Ed lost his left leg and right arm, and carries on with automail limbs.
characters.flaw: Your pride makes you take on far more than you should alone.
characters.signature: A clenched fist, a clever idea and a very loud objection.
characters.clashReason: they'd argue with you just to prove a point

characters.name: Alphonse
characters.title: The Gentle Soul
characters.summary: Kind, patient and big-hearted. You stay calm when everyone else is shouting.
description: Like Alphonse, you're kind and compassionate. He's Ed's gentle younger brother.
You keep going through the strangest situations. After a failed transmutation, Al's soul was bound to a suit of armour.
You appreciate the little things. Inside the armour, Al can't eat, sleep or feel anything, and he longs to again.
characters.flaw: You put everyone else's needs before your own.
characters.signature: A calm voice, a big heart and endless patience.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay calm when you want them to be angry with you

characters.name: Roy Mustang
characters.title: The Ambitious Leader
characters.summary: Cool, strategic and quietly ambitious. You've got a plan, and you're playing the long game.
description: Like Roy, you've got big ambitions. The Flame Alchemist is working his way up to become Führer.
You're a natural leader. Roy is Edward's commanding officer, and rises to General by the end.
You're kinder than you look. Under the cool exterior, Roy wants a fairer, more peaceful government.
characters.flaw: You play your cards so close that people can't tell whose side you're on.
characters.signature: A confident smirk and a plan five steps ahead.
characters.clashReason: they'd always be working an angle you can't see

characters.name: Riza Hawkeye
characters.title: The Steady Hand
characters.summary: Disciplined, calm and completely reliable. You're the voice of reason everyone needs.
description: Like Riza, you're the one people trust most. She's Roy Mustang's most trusted officer and his voice of reason.
You're precise and focused. Riza is a specialist sniper.
You believe in discipline. Riza raises her dog, Black Hayate, with stern but loving training.
characters.flaw: You keep your own feelings locked away behind duty.
characters.signature: A calm stare, a steady aim and a quiet 'that's enough'.
characters.clashReason: they'd keep you on schedule whether you like it or not

characters.name: Winry
characters.title: The Mechanic
characters.summary: Warm, emotional and brilliant with your hands. You fix things, and people.
description: Like Winry, you're seriously skilled. She's a gifted automail mechanic from Resembool.
You care deeply. Winry is compassionate and understanding towards the Elric brothers.
You're the heart of home. Winry was raised by her grandmother, Pinako, and eventually marries Edward.
characters.flaw: You wear your heart so openly that you get hurt easily.
characters.signature: A toolbox, a smudge of oil and a big, warm hug.
characters.clashReason: they'd take apart your stuff to see how it works

characters.name: Hughes
characters.title: The Proud Family Man
characters.summary: Cheerful, loyal and completely devoted to your family. Everyone's seen the photos.
description: Like Hughes, you love your people. He's a Lieutenant Colonel in military intelligence and Roy's best friend.
You can't stop talking about your family. Hughes spends hours bragging about them down the phone to Roy.
Everyone's seen the pictures. Hughes shows photos of his daughter, Elicia, to anyone who'll look.
characters.flaw: You talk about the people you love so much that others tune out.
characters.signature: A wallet stuffed with photos and a story about your family.
characters.clashReason: they'd show you their photos for the fifth time today

characters.name: Armstrong
characters.title: The Big Softie
characters.summary: Strong, emotional and enormously warm-hearted. You feel everything, and you're proud of it.
description: Like Armstrong, you're stronger than you look, and you look very strong. He's the Strong Arm Alchemist.
You wear your heart on your sleeve. Armstrong bursts into tears or loud praise depending on the moment.
You're proud of where you come from. Armstrong loves to show off talents 'passed down the Armstrong line for generations', often while flexing.
characters.flaw: You get carried away by your feelings, loudly.
characters.signature: Tears of joy, a dramatic speech and a flex for good measure.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every moment into an emotional event

characters.name: Izumi
characters.title: The Tough Teacher
characters.summary: Fierce, practical and secretly soft. Your love comes with a very firm hand.
description: Like Izumi, you teach the hard way. She was the Elric brothers' alchemy teacher.
You keep life practical. Izumi runs the family butcher shop.
You don't care for titles. Izumi likes to insist, 'I'm a housewife!'
characters.flaw: Your temper flares before your patience gets a chance.
characters.signature: A sharp word, a firm lesson and a pride you'll never admit to.
characters.clashReason: they'd teach you a lesson you didn't ask for

characters.name: Ling
characters.title: The Easygoing Prince
characters.summary: Laid-back, goofy and sharper than you look. You make it look easy, even when it isn't.
description: Like Ling, you've got big plans behind the grin. He's the twelfth prince of Xing.
You don't take yourself too seriously. Ling is laid-back, goofy and happily undignified.
You're cooler than you let on. Ling is also a skilled, cool-headed swordsman, though he once collapsed from sheer hunger.
characters.flaw: You act so relaxed that people underestimate how much you care.
characters.signature: A huge grin, an empty bowl and a plan nobody saw coming.
characters.clashReason: they'd eat your food and then charm their way out of it

questions.text: Someone makes a joke at your expense. You...

options.text: Explode. How dare they
Laugh along, then quietly let it go
Fire back a smooth comeback
Laugh harder than anyone

questions.text: Something wonderful happens in your family. You...

options.text: Show the photos to literally everyone, including strangers
Burst into happy tears
Celebrate quietly with the people who matter
Throw a party, and invite half the town

questions.text: A friend's bike breaks down. You...

options.text: Grab your tools, and fix it on the spot
Explain exactly why it broke, in detail
Tell them to fix it themselves. That's how you learn
Offer to help, and stay until it's done

questions.text: Your boss gives you a boring task. You...

options.text: Do it perfectly, without complaint
Do it, and think about how it gets you closer to the top
Get it done in half the time, then grumble about the wasted morning
Complain loudly, then do it brilliantly
Spend it in your workshop
Call everyone you know to tell them about your family
Eat your way through every food stall in town
Train hard, then get stuck into the jobs you've been putting off

questions.text: A friend turns up at your door in tears. You...

options.text: Sit with them, and listen for as long as they need
Cry with them. Openly
Hug them, then help fix the problem
Make them a cup of tea, then help them think it through

questions.text: You're given a tight deadline. You...

options.text: Finish it early, exactly on schedule
Delegate, and focus on the big picture
Push through without sleep, out of sheer stubbornness
Stay relaxed, then pull it off at the last minute

questions.text: Someone lectures you about how to live your life. You...

options.text: Tell them, sharply, to mind their own business
Smile, agree, and do exactly what you'd planned anyway
Laugh, and cheerfully change the subject
Thank them, and actually think about it

questions.text: You're invited to a dinner party. You...

options.text: Keep everyone laughing, and the conversation flowing
Give an emotional toast, and maybe flex a little
Bring a proper home-cooked dish, no shortcuts
End up spending the evening fixing your host's oven

questions.text: You disagree with your boss. You...

options.text: Tell them to their face
Say nothing for now, and plan to have their job one day
Back them in public, and give honest advice in private
Phone your best friend and complain for an hour

questions.text: You're a soldier, and your commanding officer is about to make a reckless call. You...

options.text: Calmly remind them exactly what's at stake
Lighten the mood, and talk them round
Follow them in anyway. Loyalty runs in your family
Ignore the order, and do it your own way

questions.text: Your teacher leaves you on an island for a month as a training test. You...

options.text: Learn everything you can from the island itself
Get hungry immediately, and complain about it
Have a little cry, then roll up your sleeves
Somehow thrive, and flex at the sea
